name: Thomas Dekker
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Thomas Dekker was a London dramatist and pamphleteer of the age of Shakespeare. The dates of his birth and death are uncertain.
Palgrave includes his song "The Happy Heart", from a play.

poems.title: The Happy Heart
poems.author: Thomas Dekker
poems.collection: The Golden Treasury, ed. F. T. Palgrave (1861)
poems.text:
Art thou poor, yet hast thou golden slumbers?
O sweet content!
Art thou rich, yet is thy mind perplexéd?
O punishment!
Dost thou laugh to see how fools are vexéd
To add to golden numbers, golden numbers?
O sweet content! O sweet, O sweet content!
Work apace, apace, apace, apace;
Honest labour bears a lovely face;
Then hey nonny nonny, hey nonny nonny!

Canst drink the waters of the crispéd spring?
O sweet content!
Swimm'st thou in wealth, yet sink'st in thine own tears?
O punishment!
Then he that patiently want's burden bears,
No burden bears, but is a king, a king!
O sweet content! O sweet, O sweet content!
Work apace, apace, apace, apace;
Honest labour bears a lovely face;
Then hey nonny nonny, hey nonny nonny!
